control.title: Vendor risk management
control.description: Keep a vendor inventory with risk tiers, assess vendors before onboarding and periodically by tier, and track their security posture.

evidence_hint: Vendor inventory with tiers and completed assessments.
acceptance_criteria: An inventory of vendors with a risk tier for each
Assessments for high-risk vendors completed in the review period

criteria_coverage.criterion: An inventory of vendors with a risk tier for each
Assessments for high-risk vendors completed in the review period

requirements.title: Extend controls to ecosystem partners
requirements.guidance: Make unregulated entities in your payment chain (payment gateways, technology providers, vendors) follow these Directions through agreements and a Board-approved policy.

requirements.title: Accountability for all processing, including by processors
requirements.guidance: The Data Fiduciary remains responsible for compliance for processing it does and processing done on its behalf by Data Processors.

requirements.title: Vendor risk and independent assurance
requirements.guidance: Manage vendor risk under the outsourcing framework, protect against infiltration from vendor environments, and get independent assurance for vendors in critical processes.

requirements.title: Vendor and partner risk
requirements.guidance: Assess and manage risks from vendors and business partners.

requirements.title: Information security in supplier relationships
requirements.guidance: Manage security risks from suppliers' products and services.

requirements.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
requirements.guidance: Monitor and review supplier security and manage changes.
